metadata.label_convention_note: Bundled labels are in the trained classifier's prediction space (label 1 = the class the model treats as positive). This may be the minority class for methods that learn on imbalanced data. AUROC, Brier, and ECE are invariant under flipping; AUCPR and threshold-dependent metrics depend on the chosen positive class. To re-derive metrics under the canonical '1 = correct' semantics, flip ground_truth_correctness ↔ 1 - ground_truth_correctness and confidence_score ↔ 1 - confidence_score, then recompute via utils.eval.calculate_all_metrics.
